contract.broadcast_model: EventBus.emit() broadcasts an event to all listeners registered under the same event name regardless of listener owner
contract.owner_independence: Listener ownership identifies the registration entry but does not restrict event delivery by emitting plugin
contract.cross_owner_delivery: A listener owned by another plugin receives the emitted event when registered for the same event name
contract.source_metadata: The emitted event preserves the plugin_id supplied to emit() as event source metadata
contract.registry_preservation: Broadcast delivery does not modify the listener registry
contract.permission_enforcement: Each registration and event emission requires the events permission
contract.architectural_boundary: Plugin ownership is enforced for registration and unregister operations, while event delivery is broadcast by event name
